_provenance.claim: minimum of 64 credits of business coursework (-UB or equivalent) in residence
-UB courses are 'business coursework' for residency
transfer back a maximum of 32 credits of non-business coursework
Non-transfer students are allowed to transfer in a maximum of 32 credits from AP, IB, foreign certificate, college credit earned prior
External transfer students can transfer in a maximum of 64 credits from their prior institution(s)
A maximum of 4 courses may be elected pass/fail during a student's academic career
No more than one course may be elected pass/fail in an academic year (fall–summer)
A course designated as pass/fail may be used to fulfill degree requirements (including BS in Business concentrations, BPE and BTE)
Courses with an automatic pass/fail grading basis (including IBEX, CLP, etc) do not count toward the 4-course limit
Stern graduate courses may not be elected pass/fail; Film & Television required coursework toward the BS/BFA Degree may not be elected pass/fail
Students do not receive credit for courses taken through the School of Professional Studies; Stern students are not permitted to enroll in courses through any SPS programs
Stern students are generally not permitted to count Stern coursework toward more than one requirement
Permission required to take more than 18 credits in a given semester
limited to students who have completed at least 32 credits and maintained a cumulative GPA of 3.0 or better
First year students may be given permission only after completing one full semester and only if GPA of 3.5 or better
the Stern curriculum only requires that students earn a minimum of 128 credits to meet most graduation requirements

_provenance.claim: A minimum 2.0 cumulative GPA is required to graduate
The Registrar automatically converts any letter grades 'A' through 'D' to 'P' for those who have elected to pass/fail the course; D is the lowest letter that converts to P
Grade of F: 4 grade points; 0 credits earned (P/F-elected F counts in GPA). IBEX failing grades factor into a student's grade point average.
